notes: Channel diorama look (styles/3d/diorama.ts + theme.css): smooth heroes, cut soil edge, heavy caps titles, word captions. Watermark @curiosferagfx.

scenes.title: ¿Por qué no se sale en las curvas?
scenes.visual: the diorama with the oval track; the train runs into the curve

scenes.title: Dos ruedas, un eje
scenes.visual: close-up of the wheelset (cylinders) on a piece of track; both wheels turn together

scenes.title: La de fuera recorre más
scenes.visual: top view of the curve: the outer wheel path (lime) and the inner one (red) grow; the outer one is longer

scenes.title: Si fueran cilindros
scenes.visual: front view: cylinder wheels; the inner one skids with sparks

scenes.title: En forma de cono
scenes.visual: close-up: the wheels turn into cones, wider inside

scenes.title: Grande fuera, pequeña dentro
scenes.visual: front view: the wheelset slides outward; lime ring on the big part outside, red ring on the small part inside

scenes.title: Misma vuelta, más camino
scenes.visual: top view of the curve; the train goes round and both wheel paths grow, the outer longer

scenes.title: La conicidad
scenes.visual: the diorama: the train takes the curve on its own

scenes.title: Baila de lado a lado
scenes.visual: the wheelset on a straight, swaying side to side more and more

scenes.title: Amortiguadores
scenes.visual: the cones flatten, dampers appear and the sway dies out

scenes.title: Curva cerrada
scenes.visual: low view along the curve: the train comes fast

scenes.title: La pestaña
scenes.visual: front view: the flange grows on each wheel; the wheelset slides out and the flange hits the rail

scenes.title: El peralte
scenes.visual: front view with a slice of the car: an arrow pushes out, then the outer rail rises and everything tilts in

scenes.title: No son cilindros, son conos
scenes.visual: the diorama: the train runs round the oval
